faq1.q: How do I cancel my booking?
faq1.a: You can cancel your booking from the Bookings tab. Select the trip you want to cancel and tap "Cancel Booking". Please note that cancellation policies vary by property.

faq2.a: Currently we only support credit/debit cards and Apple/Google Pay. We are working on adding more payment methods soon.

faq3.q: How do I contact the host?
faq3.a: Once your booking is confirmed, you will see a "Contact Host" button in your booking details. You can use the in-app chat or call them directly.

faq4.a: Yes, we use industry-standard encryption to protect your payment details. We do not store your full credit card information.

section1.title: 1. Introduction
section1.body: Welcome to Greenfox. By using our app, you agree to these Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully before making any bookings.

section2.title: 2. Bookings
section2.body: All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation by the property host. We act as an intermediary platform connecting guests with hosts.

section3.title: 3. Cancellations
section3.body: Cancellation policies vary by property. Please review the specific cancellation policy for each property before booking. Refunds are processed according to these policies.

section4.title: 4. User Responsibilities
section4.body: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account information and for all activities that occur under their account. Guests must respect property rules.

section5.title: 5. Liability
section5.body: Greenfox is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our service or any booking made through the platform.

section1.title: 1. Data Collection
section1.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create or modify your account, request services, contact customer support, or otherwise communicate with us. This information may include: name, email, phone number, and payment information.

section2.title: 2. Data Usage
section2.body: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve our services, including to facilitate payments, send receipts, provide products and services you request (and send related information), develop new features, provide customer support to Users and Hosts, develop safety features, authenticate users, and send product updates and administrative messages.

section3.title: 3. Data Sharing
section3.body: We may share the information we collect with other users (e.g. Hosts) as necessary to provide the services you request. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

section4.title: 4. Security
section4.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized or unlawful processing, accidental loss, destruction, or damage.

section5.title: 5. Your Rights
section5.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. You can manage your account settings within the app or contact our support team for assistance.
